brand_identity.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & SACRED CINEMATIC (Ancient Indian Temple Heritage + Spiritual Institution)
brand_identity.design_philosophy: Fusion of sacred Vedic geometry, Nagara architectural precision, deep celestial cosmos (Shani Dev's cosmic justice), antique brushed gold, and serene tactile warmth. Moving away from cheap temple clipart or cartoonish visuals into high-regard, reverent, cinematic spiritual authority.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.test_id_requirement: ALL interactive elements, buttons, forms, links, cards, switches, inputs MUST have clear kebab-case 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-live-darshan-button', data-testid='donation-tier-1001-button', data-testid='language-switch-hindi', data-testid='bhandara-sponsor-submit').
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.design_tone: NEVER make this look like a cheap or neon cyber page. Use deep obsidian black, rich temple indigo, antique gold borders, warm sandalwood ivory, and authentic stone carvings.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.bilingual_support: Implement full English and Hindi text translations across all views so switching language immediately updates headings, mantras, and menu items.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.admin_cms: Include complete functional admin control panel with tabbed navigation to manage Timings, Today's Bulletin, Sevas, Donations, Events, Articles, and Gallery photos.
